name: Grilled eggs
summary: Trứng nướng is grilled eggs, on the town grill list and sold as trứng gà nướng, grilled chicken eggs, at the Silver Waterfall stalls.
origin: Sa Pa town grills and the Silver Waterfall stalls.
howToEat: Pick them up with cơm lam, corn, and sweet potato for a snack after the falls walk.
where: The grills at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, and the tree stalls under Silver Waterfall.
seoTitle: Grilled eggs in Sapa — town grills and the falls
seoDescription: Trứng nướng on the Sa Pa town grills, and trứng gà nướng at the Silver Waterfall tree stalls.
